context.caption: Baseline characteristics of patients treated with LDAC plus venetoclax per ELN 2017 and ELN 2022 favorable-, intermediate-, and adverse-risk groups
context.caption_markup: Baseline characteristics of patients treated with LDAC plus venetoclax per ELN 2017 and ELN 2022 favorable-, intermediate-, and adverse-risk groups
context.foot_markup:
MR genesBCOR,EZH2,SF3B1,SRSF2,STAG2,U2AF1, andZRSR2were added in ELN 2022.

ECOG PS, Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status; WT, wild type.

Percentages were calculated based on the number of patients with non-missing values.

FLT3-ITD low is defined as aFLT3-ITD toFLT3-WT ratio of <0.5.

FLT3-ITD high is defined as aFLT3-ITD toFLT3-WT ratio of ≥0.5.
context.label: Table 1.
notes: MR genes BCOR , EZH2 , SF3B1 , SRSF2 , STAG2 , U2AF1 , and ZRSR2 were added in ELN 2022.
ECOG PS, Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status; WT, wild type.
∗ Percentages were calculated based on the number of patients with non-missing values.
† FLT3 -ITD low is defined as a FLT3 -ITD to FLT3 -WT ratio of <0.5.
‡ FLT3 -ITD high is defined as a FLT3 -ITD to FLT3 -WT ratio of ≥0.5.
